notes.subject: חמרמרה
notes.rationale: Rod חמר i kamap int ens — 'boilap olgeta, redimap olgeta' — wanpela tok, planti strong.

notes.subject: צלמות
notes.rationale: Sait bilong dai — Hibru i putim צל (sait) wantaim מות (dai) long wanpela tok; Tok Pisin i lusim dispela kamap.

notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin i laikim wanpela proman bilong holim 'sait bilong dai'; Hibru i no gat em.

translation: Pes bilong mi i redimap na i kuk long krai; na antap long ol lip bilong ai bilong mi i gat ⟨em⟩ sait bilong dai.

tokens.gloss: ol lip bilong ai bilong mi
